description: plan-it pipeline statechart — the explicit model the SKILL.md prose explains. Deterministic core: states, gates, and guards live here; the fuzzy work (research, synthesis, authoring) is LLM-at-the-node inside each state. Paste this file into https://stately.ai/viz to see the pipeline.

artifactsOnDisk.rule: Rule 3 — idle ≠ delivered. Every fan-out output must exist on disk and be non-empty before the pipeline advances.

contractFrozen.rule: Rule 1 — no frozen CONTRACT → no parallel squads. Structural check: version header, sections, changelog, no placeholders.

handoffLintClean.rule: Pre-handoff consistency gate (playbooks §F, mechanizable half): counts, IDs, Test Contract presence, token lint.

gateRecorded.rule: Rule 2 — human gates are recorded with owner + date in the state file before the pipeline advances.

adversarialDepth.rule: Rule 6 (v3.2, D4) — failure-mode depth as an exit code. When the CONTRACT declares a state machine, its failure/recovery states must be modelled (D-A1/D-A2), every declared failure state must be an asserted case outcome (D-B1), every governance rule must carry a test hook (D-B2), and the five cascade classes (partial-failure, rollback/compensation, failed-recovery→escalation, recovery/resume, adversarial-verify) must each be covered-or-waived (D-B3). Linear/CRUD workflows declare no machine → N/A → pass (no over-reach).

triageRecorded.rule: Rule 7 (E6) — a triage verdict is recorded with an allowed value and, for any non-plan verdict, a memo on disk before the run can proceed or close without a plan.

defaultsRecorded.rule: Rule 8 (E7) — every G2 decision the run defaulted for itself is recorded as a non-empty list, each row sourced "recommended", before the coherence pass proceeds.

planReviewed.rule: Rule 9 (E7) — the human plan-review round (G4) is recorded, and the PLAN-REVIEW.md artifact backing it exists on disk, before an autonomous-draft package can freeze.

meta.title: Intake
meta.does: Capture the raw vision, pointers, and use-case. Initialize .plan-it/state.json.

meta.title: Triage
meta.does: Verify a plan is warranted before starting one: record a verdict (plan, build-instead, owner-decision, skip) and, for any non-plan verdict, a memo explaining why.

meta.title: CLOSED_WITHOUT_PLAN
meta.does: The honest terminal exit for a non-plan triage verdict: a memo explaining the verdict, and where applicable a backlog entry or decision card, are written to disk. No delivery package is produced.

meta.title: Anamnesis
meta.does: The one up-front questionnaire covering everything the run will need from the human: mode, topology, and every fact only they can supply. Record owner + date.

meta.title: DoD lock
meta.does: Restructure the demand into a numbered, individually-verifiable Definition of Done + assumptions.

meta.title: Scope brief
meta.does: Render the human-readable explanation of size, shape and topology before the G1 menu.

meta.title: Scope & shape governor
meta.does: Pick size (S/M/L) + packaging shape; present with the DoD; the human approves. Record owner + date.

meta.title: Pre-ground
meta.does: Locate exact targets (paths, sessions, live-system observations) so fan-outs never work blind. Live-grounding gate for running systems.

meta.title: Discovery
meta.does: Fuzzy work: research fan-out per the chosen discovery mode. Each agent stages findings to disk.

meta.title: Preflight (env facts)
meta.does: Probe the real environment before synthesis locks anything in: emit ENV-FACTS.md (S-shape 6-probe minimal set; M/L full 9-probe set). Probes record PRESENT/ABSENT/TIMEOUT with evidence — never guessed.

meta.title: Synthesis + memory
meta.does: Fuzzy work: merge team reports into the findings doc; adversarial reconciliation; capture project memory.

meta.title: Spec authoring
meta.does: Fuzzy work: author design docs in dependency order. Model the confusing parts: every multi-step / approval-gated / agentic / concurrent workflow gets an explicit model.

meta.title: Decision round
meta.does: Batch every human-only decision into one numbered round, each with a recommendation. Lock answers with owner + date.

meta.title: Defaults applied
meta.does: Autonomous-draft path: every G2 decision the run could not ask a human for is recorded as a default, sourced "recommended", pending contradiction at plan review.

meta.title: Coherence pass
meta.does: Thread new concepts from G2 through the docs; grep for now-stale terms the decisions invalidated; fix them.

meta.title: Delivery gate
meta.does: Ask: specs aligned — proceed to the delivery package? Record owner + date.

meta.title: Backbone freeze
meta.does: Write CONTRACT.md — guided freezes to v1.0 via `freeze`; autonomous-draft freezes to v1.0-draft via `freeze --draft` — plus the program plan and STATUS board; squads build against these.

meta.title: Parallel planning
meta.does: Fuzzy work: squad fan-out writes PRDs + epics (each ending in its Test Contract) against the frozen CONTRACT. Cross-cutting findings fold back as amendments.

meta.title: Verify
meta.does: Enforce the Test Contract gate + run the pre-handoff consistency lint; fix and re-lint until clean.

meta.title: Render
meta.does: Render every deliverable twin from its manifest.

meta.title: Plan review
meta.does: The single review-and-contradict round on the complete autonomous-draft package: the human reads the whole thing at once and contradicts any default. Record owner + date; records G2 and G3 answers.

meta.title: Freeze
meta.does: Ratify the autonomous-draft CONTRACT to final (v1.0-draft → v1.0) after plan review, or send a contradiction that changes the CONTRACT back to parallel planning as an amendment.

meta.title: Handoff
meta.does: Assemble README/KICKOFF, fill the board, run the embedded glossary and mirror freshness checks, produce the launch prompt for the build agent (/build-it).

meta.title: Package delivered
meta.does: The delivery package is complete; the build runs in a fresh session.
